jobs.description:
At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started back in 2000, we have been striving to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.

We are now looking for a QA Engineer to join the Toolbox QA team.

Our team is working to evolve Toolbox into a broader part of the JetBrains ecosystem. This role covers several substantial areas at once: a desktop application, a shared local background service, and server-side and integration-heavy components that support product distribution, connectivity, and ecosystem workflows. Much of this work happens at the intersection of multiple JetBrains products and teams, so we are looking for a senior engineer who can take ownership, work proactively in ambiguous environments, and drive quality across subsystem boundaries.

In this role, you will:

- Own quality for several product areas and drive testing strategy within them.
- Participate in monthly release acceptance and help make release-readiness decisions.
- Perform functional, exploratory, regression, and acceptance testing for new and changed functionality.
- Search for, localize, and reproduce complex issues, report them in our issue tracker, and verify fixes.
- Work closely with developers during implementation, not only after features are considered ready for testing.
- Assess risks, define test scope, and decide what should be covered manually, what should be automated, and what must block a release.
- Contribute to test automation where it creates the highest value, including writing tests for some of our server-side and infrastructure-related areas.
- Collaborate with multiple JetBrains teams to validate end-to-end scenarios and reduce integration risks early.
- Help improve QA processes, release validation, and overall quality culture in the team.
- Contribute your own ideas to improve the product.
- Provide developers with recommendations on how to make the product more user-friendly, including advocating for user interests.

We will be happy to have you on our team if you:

- At least three years of experience in QA for complex software projects.
- Can work independently, take initiative, and manage tasks well.
- Are comfortable owning a broad area of responsibility and making quality decisions at the project level.
- Have experience testing desktop applications, client-server systems, or technically complex integration scenarios.
- Understand how to test systems that include UI, background processes, local services, network communication, and server-side components.
- Are confident investigating difficult problems using logs, metrics, system tools, and hypothesis-driven debugging.
- Have experience testing without complete functional specifications and can quickly build understanding in a new domain.
- Can communicate clearly with developers and other stakeholders, including in cross-team projects.
- Care deeply about product quality and user impact, not just test execution.

Technical requirements:

- Solid understanding of testing methodology, including risk-based testing, regression strategy, exploratory testing, and release validation.
- Experience testing complex applications on macOS, Windows, and Linux, and/or a good understanding of client-server architecture, HTTP, authentication flows, and integration points between components.
- Ability to investigate issues related to networking, process lifecycle, local environment, configuration, and OS-specific behavior.
- Confidence working with logs, thread dumps, command-line tools, proxies, and other debugging instruments.
- Basic programming skills sufficient to read code, understand implementation details, write small utilities, and create meaningful test scenarios.
- Familiarity with Kotlin and/or Java.
- Experience with YouTrack or similar issue trackers, CI systems, and version control workflows.

We’d be especially thrilled if you:

- Can write automated tests in Kotlin or are comfortable contributing to automation when needed.
- Have experience with integration testing, infrastructure-related testing, or validating distributed workflows.
- Have worked with release processes, release acceptance, and quality gates in products with frequent releases.
- Can define a quality approach for a new subsystem from scratch and drive it with limited guidance.
- Enjoy improving processes, not just following them.

Please keep the benefits section below for non-US job posts only
**Why join JetBrains?** 

- Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
- Flexible work location. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
- Remote work. Spend up to 30 days per year working remotely from abroad.
- Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
- Medical insurance allowance. Enjoy peace of mind for you and your family
- Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
- Language classes. Pick up the local language or sharpen your English skills.
- Fuel your day. Enjoy a hot meal or receive a lunch allowance on workdays.
- Mental health support. To help you feel your best, we provide easy access to professional mental health services.
- Sports benefit. Enjoy an on-site gym or sports club stipend.
- Internal events. Join company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

jobs.description:
E.ON Energy Projects GmbH (EEP) designs, finances, builds, operates and optimises decentralised, large-scale power generation plants for industrial customers. At E.ON diversity matters. We welcome all people and are convinced that differences make us stronger. Become part of our inclusive and diverse company culture! To create equal opportunities for everyone we offer our positions in full- or part-time.
Ready to become a Playmaker of the energy transition? Join our team in München and apply online as Grid Connection und Electrical Integration Manager (f/m/d). Are you brave enough to drive progress and forge new paths? Let’s make it work and create real impact together. We can’t wait to meet you! It’s on us, to make new energy work.

Responsibilities

- Assure the quality of the electrical integration for utility-scale BESS projects (incl. grid connection certification)
- Act as the key technical integrator in projects between EIS, TSOs/DSOs, EPC contractors, OEMs, and engineering consultants
- Coordinate interfaces between substations, HV/MV equipment, protection systems, SCADA, EMS, and BESS assets
- Ensure requirements towards substation (until grid integration EPCs are complete) and manage technical quality at interface with EPC
- Review engineering deliverables and ensure compliance with project requirements and grid connection standards
- Support project development, procurement, construction, commissioning/energization
- Identify and mitigate technical and commercial risks
- Manage external engineering partners and EPC contractors throughout project delivery
Requirements
- Degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline, with proven experience in utility-scale BESS, renewable energy, transmission, distribution, or substation projects, from conceptual phase until commissioning/energization
- Understanding of protection, control and SCADA systems, with ability to review, challenge, and validate engineering studies, designs, and technical documentation
- Familiar with grid connection processes (incl. grid connection certification), German and other European grid connection requirements, and TSO/DSO processes
- Experience with managing EPC contractors, engineering consultancies or Owner’s Engineers, and technical interface coordination across multidisciplinary engineering teams
- Excellent problem-solving, communication, influencing, and decision-making skills, with ability to identify risks, assess implications, and drive pragmatic solutions
- Commercial awareness of project risks, priorities, cost, schedule, contractual interfaces, and delivery objectives
- Fluent in German and English (C1), with 20-40% travel flexibility
Benefits
- High flexibility: Make work fit your personal life with our hybrid working model, flexible hours, and job-sharing options
- More freedom: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave plus extra days off, and find your balance with options like a 4.5-day week, a sabbatical, extra time, or extra pay
- Workation included: Make Europe your office and work up to 20 days per year from inspiring locations across the EU
- Corporate benefits: Secure your future with benefits including company pension schemes, our share programme, a range of insurance packages, and much more
- Culture of innovation: Share your ideas and unleash creativity in a collaborative, interdisciplinary environment with flat hierarchies
- Family support: Manage family life – from paid family start leave, childcare and holiday programs, to daily assistance for family members
- Modern workplace: Enjoy a multifunctional workspace that combines cutting-edge digital technology with ergonomic comfort for productivity and collaboration
- Strong team spirit: Celebrate successes and connect with colleagues at our company and team events
- Personal growth: Unlock your potential through continuous learning, diverse development opportunities, and personalized training or mentoring
- Holistic health: Embrace a healthy lifestyle with our sports, fitness, wellness, nutrition, meditation, physiotherapy, and preventive healthcare offerings
- Individual mobility: Travel your way with flexible options such as car and bike leasing, or a subsidised Deutschlandticket for public transport

jobs.occupation: Senior Developer (f/m/d) for SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning - eSPP and PP/DS (ERP-Anwendungsentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed. 
 
What you’ll do: 

Are you ready to take a senior engineering role in shaping mission-critical planning solutions at the heart of the world’s leading enterprise software company? This is an opportunity to contribute to SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning, with a focus on both SAP Extended Service Parts Planning (eSPP) and Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS). Together, these solutions help customers plan complex supply chains, optimize service levels, production resources, material availability, and operational execution across industries. 

You will work on business-critical planning capabilities used by customers with large service parts, manufacturing, warehouse, dealer, and distribution networks. Our roadmap includes modern SAP Fiori user experiences, advanced planning algorithms, forecasting, inventory planning, detailed scheduling, simulation, analytics, integration with SAP S/4HANA capabilities such as aATP, and the next wave of AI-assisted planning, optimization, and navigation. 

As a Senior Developer in our SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning team, you will: 

- Own the design, implementation, testing, and delivery of complex features across eSPP and PP/DS, with responsibility for quality, maintainability, performance, and long-term product standard compliance. 
- Apply your strong C++ background to analyze and evolve planning and optimization-related components, while also working with SAP technologies such as ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, and SAP S/4HANA integration patterns. 
- Contribute to capabilities for service parts planning, production planning, detailed scheduling, forecasting, inventory planning, stocking and destocking decisions, simulation, mass maintenance, analytics, and integration with adjacent SAP solutions. 
- Drive technical concepts, architectural improvements, refactoring, automated tests, code reviews, root-cause analysis, and defect prevention for mission-critical private cloud products. 
- Collaborate closely with product owners, architects, quality engineers, product management, and development colleagues across locations to translate customer and roadmap requirements into reliable, scalable, and user-oriented solutions. 
- Act as a technical role model for less experienced developers by sharing knowledge, reviewing designs and code, and helping the team continuously improve engineering practices. 
- Help shape the next generation of planning capabilities, including AI-assisted planning experiences, Joule-based contextual assistance, embedded analytics, and modern SAP Fiori user experiences. 
 
What you bring: 
- A good to excellent university degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Natural Sciences, or a related field. 
- Several years of professional software development experience, ideally in enterprise software, planning, optimization, logistics, supply chain, or manufacturing-related domains. 
- A strong C++ background is required, including solid understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, debugging, performance analysis, and maintainable code design. 
- Experience with SAP technologies such as ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, or SAP S/4HANA architecture is a strong plus; willingness to broaden your expertise across the SAP technology stack is expected. 
- Experience or strong interest in PP/DS, eSPP, Production Planning, Materials Management, service parts planning, detailed scheduling, or related supply chain planning processes. 
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex planning algorithms, business processes, and customer scenarios. 
- A senior mindset: ownership, technical leadership, high quality standards, clear communication, constructive collaboration, and the ability to guide others while remaining hands-on. 
- Fluent communication skills in English; German language skills are beneficial. 

Tech & topics you will work with 

- You will deepen and apply your expertise in SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning, with focus on both SAP Extended Service Parts Planning (eSPP) and Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling (PP/DS). 
- You will work across C++, ABAP, SAP Fiori, CDS views, RAP, SQL, SAP S/4HANA integration, analytics, and development practices used in mission-critical private cloud products. 
- You will contribute to planning and optimization capabilities, including forecasting, inventory planning, detailed scheduling, simulation, advanced analytics, AI-assisted planning, enterprise search, Joule-based assistance, and guided planning experiences. 
 
Meet the team: 

This senior role offers the opportunity to take technical ownership in strategic SAP planning solutions that help customers run complex after-sales, manufacturing, and supply chain planning processes more efficiently, transparently, and intelligently. You will contribute to the evolution of both eSPP and PP/DS while growing as a recognized expert in SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain Planning. 
 

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Flight Test Ground Station Systems Architect (m/w/d)

** Your location**

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

As a Systems & Software Architect for the Flight Test Ground Station (FTGS)

- you will lead the end-to-end architectural lifecycle for a complex suite of flight test tools, including FTGS-Core, FIDA, and various Add-On tools.
- you will be responsible for defining and documenting comprehensive system requirements, balancing operational needs, technical constraints, and stringent regulatory requirements.
- your core mission involves developing and iterating robust architectures encompassing hardware, software, and network infrastructure.
- Utilizing established architectural patterns and best practices, you will design modular, scalable systems and produce high-quality design specifications, interface definitions, and technical documentation.
- You will play a decisive role in evaluating and selecting the technologies and components necessary for successful system implementation, ensuring seamless interoperability and compatibility between various subsystems and external interfaces.
- Beyond design, you will drive technical excellence by establishing development best practices, conducting detailed design studies, and overseeing validation and verification (V&V) strategies. You will actively support the system integration process and contribute to the creation of test strategies to validate architecture and performance.
- A key aspect of this role is cross-functional leadership within an Integrated Product Team (IPT). You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams—including software, hardware, test, and operations engineers—to resolve complex technical challenges.
- By leading "tiger teams" to address critical issues and facilitating continuous improvement through rigorous retrospectives, you will ensure long-term technical consistency.
- Furthermore, you will remain at the forefront of the industry by monitoring emerging technologies and trends in flight test and ground station systems, ensuring the FTGS toolchain remains cutting-edge and future-proof.

** Desired skills and qualifications**

- Education: Completed university degree (Master’s or Diploma) in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science
- Professional Experience: Several years of professional experience in system architecture or the design of complex technical systems, ideally within the Aerospace or Defense sectors.
- Domain Expertise: Deep knowledge of Flight Test Ground Station systems, telemetry, data processing, and data analysis.
- Technical Proficiency:
- Advanced expertise in C++ development and software design patterns.
- Strong command of Linux environments and system administration.
- Proven experience with various software/hardware architectures and network protocols.
- Expertise in defining system requirements and creating architectural models (e.g., UML, SysML).
- Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to analyze complex technical problems and develop innovative, scalable solutions.
- Soft Skills: Strong communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to thrive in a multidisciplinary, international environment.
- Languages: Fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is mandatory.
- Travel: Willingness to undertake occasional business travel.
- Preferred: Practical experience in flight test analysis is advantageous.
